label: Design 5 - Two-Living-Room Family Plan
summary: A staged value option that tests back-side daytime living while keeping the current lounge as an evening media room and avoiding the most expensive decisions immediately.
room_changes: A daytime family room is created from Bedroom 2 plus some bright service-end space if possible.
The current lounge stays as an evening media room.
Bedroom count is kept stable only if the sunroom can become a genuine office/guest/retreat or if Bedroom 2 remains partly flexible.
Laundry and WC are compacted or relocated only as much as the budget requires.
The sunroom is retained, upgraded, or removed later.
daylight_strategy: Test whether the family uses a brighter back-side daytime room before committing to a full rebuild.
Keep the current lounge useful for lower-light evening media use.
Use deck improvements to make the daytime family room and outdoor area work together.
movement_strategy: Keep evening/media use away from main daytime traffic.
Avoid overcommitting to wet-area relocation until the back-side living pattern proves itself.
build_scope: Selective wall/opening changes around Bedroom 2, entrance, laundry, and toilet.
Furniture, lighting, and deck shade changes to test the living pattern.
No immediate requirement for a full new bedroom envelope if staged carefully.
risks: May not solve bedroom count or office needs.
Could become a half-measure if the service end cannot be released enough.
The sunroom comfort problem remains unless separately upgraded.
Needs clear staging rules so money is not spent on temporary work that will be removed later.
cost_notes: Broad planning band: NZD 60k to 180k+ depending on how much plumbing and wall work is included.
